info.title: API.SH: Fiverr
info.description: The Fiverr API from API.SH: public Fiverr data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
The gigs of a Fiverr category or subcategory page, 48 per page, with the same sorts, filters, gig fields and `facets` as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fiverr-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A fiverr.com/categories/... link or its path, e.g. `graphics-design/creative-logo-design`.

parameters.name: seller_language
parameters.description: Comma-separated two-letter languages the seller speaks, e.g. `en,es`.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: The site's price tier: 0 value, 1 mid-range, 2 high-end.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any other facet as `key:value` pairs separated by `|`, with keys and values from `facets` (e.g. `logo_type:wordmark|file_format:svg`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Fiverr reviews of a seller or a gig
get.description:
Reviews of a seller's work, or of one gig, most relevant or most recent first, 20 per call by default (`limit` 5 to 50): stars, text, language, date, reviewer name, country and photo, repeat and business buyer flags, industry, order price range and duration, the gig reviewed, work sample and seller response; plus the total and counts by industry. Filter to positive or negative reviews, or reviews with a work sample. Give `seller`, or `gig_id` / `gig` for one gig's reviews. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fiverr-reviews

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: The Fiverr username, or the seller's fiverr.com link. Required unless `gig_id`, `gig` or `cursor` is given.

parameters.name: gig_id
parameters.description: Only reviews of this gig (`id` from /fiverr/v1/gig, or `reviews_endpoint` there).

parameters.name: gig
parameters.description: Only reviews of this gig, by its fiverr.com link or `<seller>/<gig>` path.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only positive reviews, only negative reviews, or only reviews with a work sample.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous answer (with the same `sort` and `filter`); null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Gigs matching a search, 48 per page, with the site's sorts and filters: id, title, link, starting price, delivery days, number of packages, gig rating and reviews, seller (username, name, country, level, rating and count, online, languages, photo), Pro, Fiverr's Choice and promoted flags, hourly rate, consultation offer, category ids, images and service attributes (e.g. logo style, file formats). Plus the total and `facets`: every filter with its values and gig counts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fiverr-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
